scope: R3 generic state-cache budget and retention candidate; CPU validated, GPU/performance unmeasured

cpu.exclusion: tests/kernel contains existing manual CUDA scripts with import-time GPU allocation; CPU suite excludes that directory.

contract.state_memory_ratio: Optional state bytes / KV bytes, overrides manual cached-state count; no model-specific default
contract.state_fraction: ratio/(1+ratio) of paired post-load available bytes
contract.mandatory_state: Working slots plus overlap scratch are included; automatic cached capacity is the remainder
contract.tp_coordination: MIN cached slot count, then MIN remaining bytes after each rank subtracts its own state reservation
contract.insufficient_rank: Every rank reaches the count collective before a common MemoryError
contract.unified_memory: Derive state ceiling from actual aligned arena, including explicit page cap
contract.retention: No implicit per-path checkpoint limit; global capacity and existing branch-aware LRU remain authoritative. Explicit per-path limits still supported.

validation: Static and shared arenas, mandatory scratch, dtype byte accounting
Different rank memory availability and state footprints; existing paired-budget counterexamples preserved
Earlier fork checkpoint survives more than four snapshots and restores its original state
CLI automatic and manual checkpoint-budget options are mutually exclusive
limitations: No new GPU experiment submitted for R3 while devices need recovery
Full corrected R2 quality/real graph coverage and R2 AIPerf still precede R3 serving measurement
No measured throughput/latency gain claimed; lazy extra-buffer ownership and native communication integration remain unfinished
